newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's Tung to attend APEC with China's Jiang.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tung to attend APEC with China's Jiang.

text.p: Hong Kong leader Tung Chee-hwa will attend an Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in November in Canada together with China's President Jiang Zemin, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
A spokeswoman at Tung's office declined to comment.
Tung would also visit the United States in September to meet President Bill Clinton and members of Congress, the Hong Kong Economic Journal said, quoting unnamed sources.
The Beijing-backed Tung took office on July 1, when Britain handed this former colony of 156 years back to China.
Under the Sino-British treaty on Hong Kong, it is promised a high degree of autonomy for 50 years under the "one country two systems" formula of China's late leader Deng Xiaoping.
At the APEC meeting Jiang and Tung would tell world leaders of Hong Kong's stable transition and successful implementation of the "one country, two systems" policy, the newspaper said.
